title: Gamescom Opening Night Live 展示网易、Hoyoverse、腾讯等重磅新作
content:
Gamescom’s Opening Night Live showcases major new NetEase, Hoyoverse and Tencent titles – Mobilegamer.biz
Skip to content
Here are all the new mobile games shown during Gamescom’s Opening Night Live, including titles from NetEase, Hoyoverse and more.
Genshin Impact maker Hoyoverse also revealed Elden Ring-like game
Nodus Fall
during the Geoff Keighley-fronted showcase, but there’s no confirmation on whether it is coming to mobile or not just yet.
Ananta (NetEase)
Stylish anime open-world action RPG from NetEase, confirmed for mobile, PS5 and Xbox. It’s slated to release on January 15, 2027.
Sea of Remnants (NetEase)
Open-world roguelike RPG from NetEase, due on PC, PS5, Xbox Series X|S, iOS and Android in 2027. A global closed beta arrives in December, with
pre-registration now open
for iOS and Android.
Monster Hunter Outlanders (Timi/Capcom)
Open-world survival action game bringing Monster Hunter to mobile, developed by Timi under license from Capcom. It’s coming to iOS and Android in 2026, and pre-registration is open.
Petit Planet (Hoyoverse)
Cutesy life sim from Hoyoverse, the studio behind Genshin Impact. Releasing in winter 2026 on mobile and PC, we got a new trailer at the show.
Roco Kingdom (Morefun Studios/Tencent)
This is a Palworld-style creature collector going global on mobile, PC, PS5 and Xbox. A closed beta starts on October 27 on PC, iOS and Android, with the full launch pencilled for late 2027. Pre-registration is open now.
Silver Palace: House of Greed (Elementa)
A lavish fantasy open-world action RPG, Silver Palace used its Gamescom slot to reveal House of Greed, a new multiplayer mode. It’s coming to mobile, PC and PS5, but there’s no release date yet.
